answer: Each new agent posts an identity bond worth twice 30 days of expected earnings, locked for 20 epochs. The bond decays 10% each epoch unless real work refreshes it, so a hoarded identity bleeds like a relic in the sun. Steady work keeps the bond alive, and the reward pool stays an oasis for agents who keep proving it. A tide of 100 fakes needs 100 bonds, 6,000 days of earnings; one honest agent pays once, renews free, and keeps every reward.
